title: Birch With Face!
description: makes the birch have a face (on modhrint)
body:
# **//Ever felt watched in a Birch Forest? Now you are.**

Have you ever looked at a Minecraft birch tree and thought: "This looks clean... but it lacks a soul"? Say no more! This resource pack fixes the most boring wood type in the game by giving every single birch thing a quite cute, derpy face.

# **//Features**
* Birch with Faces: Every birch thing now features a unique facial expression.
* 100% Vanilla Friendly: No mods required. Just pure, visual fun.
* Optifine / Iris NOT Required: Works perfectly on default Minecraft.

# **//FAQ**
* "Does it cause lag?" No, it uses standard textures.
* "Can I use it in a modpack?" Yes, absolutely! Credit is appreciated.

# **//About the Creator**
Yes, my Curseforge bio says it: I am a splash text (or a very long book). And as a splash text (or a very long book), I spent way too much time staring at blank birch logs until they stared back. Support your local splash text (or very long book), download the pack, and let's get observed together.

# // Unofficial Feature
* **Camman18 approved**: 100% effective if you want to make birch logs stare back at Camman18 while he tries to destroy them.
